Functional description

The current socket/cigar lighter

P50

is supplied by the line controlled by the ignition (INT/A) of relay T12 protected by fuse F44, both contained in the unit under the dashboard

B2

.

The lighting up of the cigar lighter

P50

with side lights on is controlled by the Body Computer

M1

- pin 18 of connector C.

The additional rear current socket

P52 is also supplied by the line controlled by the ignition (INT/A) of relay T12 protected by fuse F44, both contained in the unit under the dashboard B2.
